major_event: 2026-08-31 reported exploit affecting the mFlowWFLOW lending reserve on Flow EVM. Blockaid-linked reporting described approximately 15.5 million WFLOW leaving the reserve and an initial detector-impact estimate near USD 9.3 million. MORE Markets said it was investigating the exploit claim; final loss, root cause, recovery and lender outcome remain unresolved.

duplicate_check.notes: Immediate DeFi incident staging under corrected CYA scope. Hardened canonical duplicate scan remains required before promotion.

scope_review.current_action: Eligible for CYA review as a historically significant DeFi lending incident under the corrected CeFi+DeFi scope.

incident_review.preliminary_mechanism: Blockaid-linked reporting connected the incident to an Ankr bonded liquid-staking token and MORE Markets E-Mode; this must not be treated as a final root-cause finding until first-party or technical postmortem evidence is available.
unresolved: whether the reported USD figure represents realized economic loss
market pause, restart and remediation outcome

notes: Do not describe the preliminary USD estimate as a confirmed final loss. MORE Markets is a decentralized non-custodial lending protocol on Flow EVM; DeFi architecture is not an exclusion reason under the corrected CYA scope.
